Colorado Rocky Mountains Award-Winning Ski-In Ski-Out Luxury

Telluride, United States

Welcome to the ultra-luxe Lumière with Inspirato: a stunning, European-inspired boutique lodge with an exclusive ski-in, ski-out location at the foot of the San Juan Mountains in the Colorado Rockies. Enjoy the best of both worlds with direct access to Lift 4 in Mountain Village, with the world-renowned après-ski of nearby Telluride just a 15-minute drive away. Indulge in one of 18 sumptuous, mountain-view studios and residences, all fitted with wood-panelled décor to reflect the natural beauty of the surrounding snow-capped mountains, designer furniture and chef's kitchens. With recognition from the prestigious Condé Nast Readers’ Choice Awards 2021 (#2 Best Hotel in Colorado) and USA Today Top 10 Ski Hotels 2021, this award-winning hotel creates a home-away-from-home with an intimate, upscale restaurant and bar, black tie ski valet service and blissful massages - with a world-class ski resort right on the doorstep.
